map.Cp 只看规格宽度与过程离散程度、假设过程均值恰好居中；Cpk 额外计入均值相对: Cp only looks at the specification width and the process spread, assuming the process mean sits exactly at the center; Cpk additionally accounts for how far the mean is from the center of the specification, which is the capability actually achievable. When the mean is centered Cpk=Cp, and the larger the offset the smaller Cpk, so Cpk is the more conservative and more commonly used criterion.

map.评估工序在统计受控状态下满足规格要求的潜在能力，只看规格宽度与过程离散程度，不考: Assesses the potential capability of a process to meet specification while statistically in control, looking only at the specification width and the process spread, not at whether the mean is centered.
map.输入规格上限 USL、下限 LSL 与过程标准差 σ，工具计算 Cp 过程能力指: Enter the upper specification limit USL, the lower limit LSL and the process standard deviation σ to compute the Cp process capability index, which measures the ratio of specification width to process spread (ignoring offset) and judges whether the process can stably meet tolerance.
map.过程能力研究用『组内标准差』（如子组极差法、移动极差法），代表短期、固有波动；不: Capability studies use the "within-group standard deviation" (such as the subgroup range method or moving range method), which represents short-term inherent variation. Do not use the overall standard deviation that includes special causes, or you will overstate variation and understate capability. The overall standard deviation is for long-term metrics such as Pp/Ppk.
map.：Cp = (USL − LSL) / (6σ)，其中 σ 为过程标准差（能力研: : Cp = (USL - LSL) / (6σ), where σ is the process standard deviation (capability studies use the within-group standard deviation, not the overall one), and 6σ is the natural process spread (±3σ). Verdict: Cp >= 1.67 means capability is excessive (tolerance can be widened or cost reduced); 1.33 <= Cp < 1.67 is sufficient; 1.00 <= Cp < 1.33 is marginal; Cp < 1.00 is insufficient and needs improvement. Note that Cp ignores the mean offset, so look at Cpk when the mean is off-center.
map.：轴径规格 10±0.05 mm，即 USL=10.05、LSL=9.95，过程: : shaft diameter spec 10±0.05 mm, i.e. USL=10.05, LSL=9.95, process σ=0.01: Cp = (10.05-9.95)/(6x0.01) = 0.10/0.06 ≈ 1.667, above 1.33 and close to 1.67, so capability is sufficient. If the process variation grows to σ=0.02, Cp = 0.10/0.12 ≈ 0.833 < 1.00, capability is clearly insufficient and reducing the variation should take priority over adjusting the mean.
